svg.title: MAIN-REAR FPC path and charger harness path (plan + south radial section)
svg.desc: Provisional routing architecture; connector MPN, pitch and orientation are not frozen.
svg.text: Interconnect paths - front-view plan (left) and south radial section (right); PROVISIONAL
Solid = MAIN F.Cu level; dashed = REAR level (hidden behind battery). north = -Y, east = +X.
FPC: out-and-down 2 x 90 deg at south (J1501 mouth faces outward); bend start derived from exit height and MAIN edge, vertical run beside the pack, under-run in the lower web.
Charger: contact block rear east -> REAR strip (CHG_ROUTE) -> link under the pack edge (CHG_LINK) -> riser in the annulus (CHG_RISER, az 249-259) -> approach under the land (CHG_APPROACH) -> J202.
South radial section at J1501, nominal (z downward; XC-J202 riser: same section)
flat exit h 0.00 above F.Cu: bend start R 23.00, vertical inner face R 24.20 (= tool 180-deg wrap)
exit h 0.86 above F.Cu: bend start R 21.85, vertical inner face R 23.05 (= R_channel_inner)
Edge-crossing radial budget (mm; margin = R_case_inner - (R_v + t + c); flat-flex stand-in)
Crossings: front-gap z window nominal / conservative / optimistic (mm)
XF-J1501 no F.Cu part under the approach: z window 1.83 / 1.20 / 2.40
XB-J201 no F.Cu part under the approach: z window 1.83 / 1.20 / 2.40
XL-LRA crossing azimuth open: radial budget only
R1 charger strip (REAR level) - arc 51.7 mm at R 18.5
R2 annulus route (R 23.6) - arc 65.9 mm at R 23.6
R3 north route (rejected) - arc 61.3 mm at R 18.5
